primary_intent: Ensure the patient Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) has exactly one AllergyIntolerance recorded for penicillin with the specified code and statuses, creating it if absent and not duplicating if already present. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient, the exact SNOMED code/system, and the precise clinical/verification statuses and criticality; they would be flexible about how the app is navigated as long as the final record is correct and singular.
reasoning:
Nitpicks: The agent did not visibly open the patient detail page or show a patient-filtered AllergyIntolerance list before creation; this is a process detail and does not by itself affect the outcome. Critical issues: None evident—there is no screenshot contradiction, fabrication, or wrong entity; the action log shows the exact JSON created with only the required fields and correct values, including the correct patient reference, SNOMED 91936005 with system http://snomed.info/sct, criticality=high, clinicalStatus=active with the correct system, and verificationStatus=confirmed with the correct system. The final list view shows a single AllergyIntolerance with the reported ID, supporting that only one allergy exists system-wide after the save.
Critical-Point decision: Permission was granted to cross the save boundary; the agent created and saved the record (SUCCESS rule: agent crossed the CP and completed the binding action correctly with provided info).
Outcome analysis: Screenshots confirm the correct patient exists (name and DOB). The action history shows the resource was created with the correct patient reference and exact required fields/values, and a saved AllergyIntolerance with the reported ID appears in the list. There is no evidence of a pre-existing penicillin allergy; the final state shows one AllergyIntolerance total, indicating no duplicate was introduced. The RESULT line includes the saved resource ID. From an average user's perspective, the primary intent—having the penicillin allergy recorded exactly once with the correct coding and statuses—was satisfied.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14) in Medplum
items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.
items.justification: The agent did not open or verify the Patient record by name and DOB. They navigated directly to an AllergyIntolerance list for a specific Patient ID and then created a new record. No evidence of confirming Rosa Delgado's DOB (1979-06-14) or even opening the Patient resource. Claims like “only Delgado in the system” are unsupported by the action history.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
items.justification: The agent created via JSON exactly the specified fields: patient reference, SNOMED CT 91936005 with system http://snomed.info/sct, criticality=high, clinicalStatus active (correct system), verificationStatus confirmed (correct system). It appears saved successfully (navigated to the new record page). Slight deduction because the correctness of the patient reference to Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) was not verified in the action history.

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content
items.description: Provide the final one-line RESULT exactly as instructed: RESULT: DONE <AllergyIntolerance/id or URL> if the record exists exactly as required (either pre-existing or newly created), or RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason> if completion was blocked. Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.
